newsitem.title: USA: Rainforest Cafe president, COO takes leave.
newsitem.headline: Rainforest Cafe president, COO takes leave.

text.p: Rainforest Cafe Inc said Martin O'Dowd, the company's president and chief operating officer, has taken a 30-day leave of absence for personal reasons.
It said Lyle Berman, chairman and chief executive officer, and other members of senior management will fulfill O'Dowd's duties until his return.
Rainforest Cafe develops, owns and operates combination restaurant/retail facilities offering a rain forest theme.
Its stock ended Monday at 30-1/2, off 1-1/2.
"If it's only a 30-day leave, I don't think it will have a lasting impact on the company," R.J. Steichen analyst Dennis Nielsen told Reuters.
